title: One Project, Many Environments
subtitle: A proposal: give every deployment its own environment record, instructions, and trigger

chapters.title: The Problem
chapters.blurb: One target URL and one set of instructions per project cannot describe a product that runs in many places, and override URLs leave runs with no environment identity.

chapters.title: The Database Solution
chapters.blurb: Expand, migrate, contract: add project_environments, classify existing URLs into environments behind a read-path feature flag, repoint test runs, then drop the old columns.

chapters.title: Different Environments, Different Triggers
chapters.blurb: Production runs nightly on weekdays, staging runs when a deploy to main completes, pull requests run when ready for review, and journeys default to every environment with per-world opt-outs.
